Fix the Invader Privacy Policy
Last updated: November 8, 2026

Fix the Invader is a game that runs entirely in your browser. We respect your privacy and do not collect any personal information from you when you play it.

1. Information We Collect

None. Fix the Invader has no accounts, no sign-in, and no server-side processing. The game runs locally on your device.

2. Data Storage

Your music and sound settings are stored only in your browser's local storage, on your own device. They never leave it, and clearing your browser data removes them completely.

3. Third-Party Analytics

We do not use any analytics tools, trackers, or advertising software.

4. Children's Privacy

We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children under the age of 13, because the game does not collect information at all.

5. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to make changes to this Privacy Policy at any time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the revised Privacy Policy on our website.

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at info@yellowduckgames.com.
